subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Whistleblowers Who Changed History
description: A fast breakdown of Whistleblowers Who Changed History for builders.

hook.text: Daniel Ellsberg, Mark Felt, Edward Snowden — whistleblowers who risked everything to expose truth.

buildup.text: Whistleblowers reveal government or corporate wrongdoing that would otherwise stay hidden.

discovery.text: Snowden's leaks led to real reform: the USA Freedom Act limited bulk phone data collection.

twist.text: Most whistleblowers face prosecution, exile, or ruin. The system punishes those who expose it.

climax.text: Whistleblowers are the last line of defense when oversight fails — and the most vulnerable.

punchline.text: Expose the truth. Pay the price. Every time.

quiz.question: What reform followed Edward Snowden's disclosures?
options: The USA Freedom Act limited bulk phone data collection
All NSA programs were shut down
Snowden was pardoned and returned home
